title: MatrixArk Ingest Envelope
description: Canonical request schema for ALL non-agent ingestion into MatrixArk / TemporalStore. Every non-agent ingest call (kind in {message, feedback, resource, skill, business_data}) is normalized by tools/matrixark_mcp_core.py::normalize_envelope (via resolve_ingest_messages + the require_messages/optional_object helpers in tools/matrixark_mcp_core_identity.py, which matrixark_mcp_core re-exports), and this schema DESCRIBES that normalizer's accepted input contract. normalize_envelope is the source of truth; this schema must never impose a rule the code does not. The agent-capture path (integrations/agent-hooks/shared/agent_event_schema.json) is a SEPARATE capture format that agent hooks normalize INTO this same envelope; it is not this schema. NOTE (documented code leniencies not fully expressed here): message roles are matched case-insensitively after trimming and non-canonical aliases (see message.role) are normalized to the four canonical roles; ingestion_time_ms is also accepted by the code as a numeric string or float (coerced via int()); scope/metadata accept null (treated as {}); for resource/skill a raw_uri whose value is exactly "inline-resource" is NOT treated as a source (text or messages must then be supplied). additionalProperties is true because normalize_envelope copies through passthrough fields; the known ones are documented under properties.

kind.description: Ingestion kind. Optional in a raw call (the gateway supplies a per-endpoint default_kind), but when present must be one of the enum. Drives the content requirement below.

messages.description: Conversation/content turns. Required and non-empty for kind in {message, feedback, business_data}; for {resource, skill} it is one acceptable content source among messages|text|raw_uri.

text.description: Client-facing single-call content for resource/skill ingest (alias: resource_text). Synthesized into a one-item user messages list by resolve_ingest_messages.

resource_text.description: Alias of text accepted for resource/skill single-call ingest.

raw_uri.description: Local-file path or URI source for resource/skill ingest (passthrough for other kinds). The literal value "inline-resource" is a placeholder and is NOT treated as a real source.

scope.description: Access/ownership scope. Optional; null is treated as an empty object. All subfields are optional strings.

sharing_scope.description: Sharing visibility. Read from scope.sharing_scope (or top-level); defaults to private_user.

metadata.description: Free-form metadata object. Optional; null is treated as an empty object. May carry ingestion_time_ms and storage_options overrides.

ingestion_time_ms.description: Ingestion timestamp in epoch milliseconds. Optional; defaults to now. Must be a positive integer (the code also accepts a numeric string/float, coerced via int()).

expires_at.description: PurchaseMemory per-record TTL (optional). Absolute expiry as unix SECONDS (int/float). Every record produced by this ingestion is stamped ephemeral and stops surfacing from retrieve/get_all once now >= expires_at, is excluded from summaries/rollups, and is lazily purged. Wins over ttl_seconds when both are given. Normalized by apply_memory_envelope_fields into expires_at_ms.

ttl_seconds.description: PurchaseMemory relative TTL (optional). expires_at = occurred_at (ingestion_time) + ttl_seconds. Ignored when expires_at is also supplied.

retention_cutoff_ts.description: PurchaseMemory scope-level retention cutoff (optional), unix SECONDS. Records in this subject scope whose occurrence time < cutoff are hidden at read-time and reclaimed by the expiry sweep. Persisted as a durable scope marker.
